environment.description: Same application deployed in a Kubernetes pod with a distroless base image. Pod security context specifies `drop: [ALL]` capabilities with only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE added back. The pod runs with a read-only root filesystem and an Istio sidecar proxy enforcing mTLS STRICT mode between all services in the mesh. The Istio AuthorizationPolicy restricts inbound traffic to the pod to only originate from the ingress gateway VirtualService which has a custom EnvoyFilter applying header-based session binding: the filter computes an HMAC of the client's TLS certificate fingerprint concatenated with the session cookie value, and rejects requests where the HMAC doesn't match a server-set `X-Session-Bind` response header. Redis is accessed via a separate ServiceEntry with mTLS and RBAC restricting session store writes to authenticated pod identity only.

config.envoy_filter: Custom Lua filter computing HMAC(client_cert_fingerprint + session_cookie) for session binding validation
config.redis_access: mTLS ServiceEntry with RBAC, pod SPIFFE identity required
